experiment: P4i concurrent execution for compact heterogeneous route
research_question: Can two CUDA streams execute the independent MLCNN classification and width-4 IQ-Grouped parameter branches concurrently, preserving exact outputs while removing the batch-one scheduling latency that stopped P4h?

single_mechanism.baseline_execution: the two task branches execute serially on the current CUDA stream
single_mechanism.candidate_execution: classification and parameter branches execute on two persistent CUDA streams; the caller stream waits for both before returning

benchmark_protocol.timing: CUDA events with synchronization after the end event
benchmark_protocol.memory: peak CUDA allocated bytes after warmup

stop_rule: Do not alter stream count, batch protocol, warmup, repeats or gates after reading timing results. If concurrent execution fails output equivalence or either batch-one latency gate, stop the two-stream deployment line and move to a shared or fused front end on a new preregistration. Do not train the compact route merely because MACs are matched.
next_if_pass: Freeze the two-stream runner and preregister a fresh-identity three-seed compact-route accuracy experiment; the accuracy candidate must use the same width-4 architecture and deployment runner.
